parsed.why: Most Protective tier: care shield law expressly covering visitors from ban states, statewide gender-identity accommodations and hate-crime protections, no facility ban, no documented anti-trans violence. National border/document and federally funded facility exposures still apply, capping the score.

Only state criminalising adult restroom/changing use in private businesses including hospitals, up to a year's jail — universal, inescapable exposure even if unenforced; litigation unresolved. No documented GI recourse offsets it.

Criminal facility exclusion enforced within days (trooper ID checks), top Do Not Travel tier, binary sex-definition act, no gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime coverage, custody care denial. Killings near background rate, not a campaign.

Facility restrictions in schools and all state-owned buildings, plus care bans for minors and adults in public facilities; no gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime recourse. Reach narrower than states criminalising private-business facilities.

No current facility ban — 2016 law repealed after backlash, 2025 bill only pending; courts acted for trans claimants. But no GI hate-crime coverage, prison transition-care funding ban, local-only protections. Undercount violence figure is no evidence.
